mentions.heading: If our warranty reserves are inadequate to cover future warranty claims on our products
mentions.detail: Uncertainty greater for recently introduced products and those planned at significantly higher volumes
mentions.quote: Such estimates are inherently uncertain and changes to our historical or projected experience, especially with respect to products that we have introduced relatively recently and/or that we expect to produce at significantly greater volumes than our past products, may cause material changes to our warranty reserves in the future.

mentions.heading: Our insurance coverage strategy may not be adequate to protect us from all business risks
mentions.detail: Maintains less insurance than many companies, sometimes none; significant deductibles and self-insured retentions
mentions.quote: As a general matter, we do not maintain as much insurance coverage as many other companies do, and in some cases, we do not maintain any at all.

mentions.heading: Our debt agreements contain covenant restrictions that may limit our ability to operate our business
mentions.detail: Limits on additional debt and liens; minimum liquidity requirement; breach could trigger acceleration
mentions.quote: In addition, under certain circumstances we are required to maintain a certain amount of liquidity. As a result of these covenants, our ability to respond to changes in business and economic conditions and engage in beneficial transactions, including to obtain additional financing as needed, may be restricted.

mentions.heading: Additional funds may not be available to us when we need or want them
mentions.detail: Capital-intensive expansion, AI-enabled fleet and Bots production; may need funding to refinance indebtedness
mentions.quote: Our business and our future plans for expansion, supporting infrastructure for our businesses, and AI innovations, including growth in our fleet of AI-enabled company-operated assets and new businesses, such as our development and production of Bots, are capital-intensive, and the specific timing of cash inflows and outflows may fluctuate substantially from period to period.

mentions.heading: We may be negatively impacted by any early obsolescence of our manufacturing and other equipment
mentions.detail: Product or process changes may retire installed manufacturing equipment early
mentions.quote: The useful life of any equipment that would be retired early as a result would be shortened, causing such depreciation to be accelerated, and our results of operations may be harmed.

mentions.heading: There is no guarantee that we will have sufficient cash flow from our business to pay our indebtedness
mentions.detail: $8.18 billion aggregate principal indebtedness at December 31, 2025; may incur additional debt
mentions.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we and our subsidiaries had outstanding $8.18 billion in aggregate principal amount of indebtedness (see Note 9, Debt, to the consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K).
